svg.title: A child weighing 18 kg is prescribed a medication at 15 mg/kg/dose every 6 hours. The reference states a maximum of 1,000 mg per dose and 4,000 mg in 24 hours. The pharmacy supplies 250 mg/5 mL.
svg.desc: 18 kg times 15 mg/kg is 270 mg per dose, which is well within the 1,000 mg single-dose ceiling, and four doses give 1,080 mg in 24 hours, within the daily maximum. Checking both the per-dose and the daily maximum is the habit that catches ten-fold errors, which are the classic and most damaging pediatric medication mistake.
